title: IPL photo-rejuvenation (pigment, redness)
what: A machine shines bright flashes of light on your skin. The light lightens dark spots and reduces redness and small blood vessels.
why: For dark spots, freckles, redness of the face and thread veins.
duration: the procedure usually takes 20 to 40 minutes, and a course usually has several sessions
tell_doctor: If you have sunbathed or used a tanning bed in the past weeks
If you take medicines that make you sensitive to the sun
If you get cold sores on your lips
If you have moles in the treated area

prepare.title: Sun
prepare.text: Usually no sun or tanning bed for 2 to 4 weeks before. Ask the clinic.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Tell the doctor everything you take.

steps: A cool gel is applied to your skin
The doctor places the device head and flashes of light fire
The gel is removed and a soothing cream and sunscreen are applied
feel: A flash feels like a rubber band snap and warmth
Afterwards the skin is red, usually for a few hours
Spots first get darker and then flake off in 1 to 2 weeks
after: Do not pick off the darkened crusts - they will fall off on their own
Usually no bath house, peels or scrubs for a few days
The next session is at the time your doctor sets
red_flags: Blisters, weeping skin or a burn
White or very dark patches that were not there before - see your doctor

faq.q: Why are the spots darker after the procedure?
faq.a: This is how it should be: the pigment rises to the surface and comes off in 1 to 2 weeks.

faq.q: Can I do it in summer?
faq.a: The procedure is usually done in the season without strong sun. Ask your doctor.

reminders.text: Photo-rejuvenation tomorrow. Come without makeup or self-tanner. If you were in the sun recently, tell your doctor.
